verdict.rationale: Square's docs confirm a single Payments API supporting cards, ACH bank transfers, Afterpay/Clearpay (BNPL), and Cash App payments, all through one integration and one Payments API surface. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents Apple Pay or Google Pay wallet support, nor broader bank-redirect methods beyond ACH, so full breadth of 'digital wallets and local payment methods' claimed in the story isn't directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit Apple Pay/Google Pay API documentation, additional local bank-redirect methods, independent confirmation of unified wallet support.
